about.title: About | fitty.ar
about.description: Software developer: .NET, Rust, web. Own products and commercial projects in production.
about.hero_subtitle: I'm {strong}, a developer from Buenos Aires. I build custom software in .NET, tooling in Rust, and web apps. My projects are in production with real clients and as independent products.
about.section_stats_title: Numbers that sum up the path.
about.section_stats_subtitle: No inflation. What is, what it took, what's next.
about.section_timeline_subtitle: Layers accumulated, not pivots. Each project fed the next.
about.section_principles_subtitle: Short rules I apply to every project.
about.journey_01_body: My first piece of work sold and put into production. A catalog system for an auto parts shop. Years ago now, deprecated: the client today runs something bigger than that project.
about.journey_02_title: From Techparts to ElectroObra and Flota-HAS
about.journey_02_body: From that first project to two more commercial products in production: ElectroObra (construction management) and Flota-HAS (ride-hailing). Real software, with real users.
about.journey_03_body: Open own products. PolyglotCLI for translating PDFs with local LLMs, Cardfile as a cross-platform card organizer.
about.journey_04_body: A TUI file manager written in Rust with Ratatui and Tokio. Learning systems programming with a project that's actually used.
about.journey_05_body: A video game in Godot Engine. Immersive narratives, mechanics from scratch. In design phase, with constant iteration.
about.journey_06_body: Self-hosted Astro portal that centralizes access to internal tools behind the VPN. No database, editable from an admin panel. Product in use.
about.principle_01_body: Small, reversible, measurable releases. One change at a time that you can understand and revert.
about.principle_02_body: User data on their machine. Optional sync. Privacy by default, not as an add-on.
about.principle_03_body: I prefer readable code over clever code. Abstractions have to earn their place.
about.principle_04_body: The "what" is in the code. The "why" deserves its own paragraph in the commit or README.
about.principle_05_body: Trying new things is part of the job. Last month: TUI in Rust, local models, micro-frontends.
about.principle_06_body: If I can't explain what a tool is for, I don't put it in the stack. The portfolio reflects the code, not the trends.
about.cta_subtitle: If the profile interests you, the next step is simple: tell me what you have in mind.
